provenance.line: the JsonData arm calls pipeline.process(payload) with no converter in between
provenance.producer: filebeat shipping over lumberjack to dfe-receiver
provenance.note: Filed under beats, not receiver, and that is the point. Lumberjack is the Beats wire protocol, so the frame payload is a Beats document and the receiver adds nothing to it -- there is no convert.rs in that directory. This is the case that fixes the rule: family is decided by what the payload LOOKS like, never by who delivered it. The event below is the module fixture's, since that is what a filebeat sends.
